commit f7157a5fafe7f839b97f5afac2aaab70277b97b3
Author:     Martin Giger <martin@humanoids.be>
AuthorDate: Wed Dec 10 11:45:28 2025 +0000
Commit:     Martin Giger <martin@humanoids.be>
CommitDate: Wed Dec 10 11:45:28 2025 +0000

    Bug 2004906 - Remove stylistic rules that are addressed by prettier. r=aleca
    
    I've checked that all of them are still covered by prettier.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D275598

diff --git a/.stylelintrc.js b/.stylelintrc.js
index 18b7a4407cc..cd1abc042b0 100755
--- a/.stylelintrc.js
+++ b/.stylelintrc.js
@@ -29,7 +29,7 @@ const ignoreFiles = [
 
 module.exports = {
   extends: ["stylelint-config-recommended"],
-  plugins: ["@stylistic/stylelint-plugin", "stylelint-use-logical"],
+  plugins: ["stylelint-use-logical"],
   ignoreFiles,
   rules: {
     /* Disabled because of `-moz-element(#foo)` which gets misparsed. */
@@ -262,14 +262,6 @@ module.exports = {
     "media-feature-name-value-no-unknown": true,
     "max-nesting-depth": 5,
 
-    "@stylistic/color-hex-case": "lower",
-    "@stylistic/selector-list-comma-newline-after": "always",
-    "@stylistic/selector-max-empty-lines": 0,
-    // attribute selector should "look like html"
-    "@stylistic/selector-attribute-operator-space-before": "never",
-    "@stylistic/selector-attribute-operator-space-after": "never",
-    "@stylistic/selector-attribute-brackets-space-inside": "never",
-
     "csstools/use-logical": "always",
   },
 };
title: Bug 2004906 - Remove stylistic rules that are addressed by prettier. r=aleca
